key_insight: Factorial analysis identified HVOF settings yielding acceptable hardness, porosity, and oxide attributes for Cr₃C₂-20(Ni20Cr) coatings on Ti6Al4V.
engineering_relevance: The reported settings—150 mm standoff, 25 g/min powder feed, 475 NLPM hydrogen, and 205 NLPM oxygen—provide a starting point for this coating–substrate combination.
method: Used a full factorial design with 24 experimental runs and two-level input factors.
Measured coating properties and applied ANOVA to quantify spray-parameter contributions.
Used Pareto charts to examine parameter interaction effects.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports coating-property measurements across 24 runs but gives no numerical response values or uncertainty estimates.
watch_item: Validate the reported settings on the intended equipment; transferability and in-service performance are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: Investigation of the Effect of HVOF Spray Parameters on the Quality Properties of Cr3C2-20(Ni20Cr) Coating on Ti6Al4V Substrate
